name: Voxel Color Aggregation into Brick Faces
definition: A shader that aggregates voxel colors from a voxel fragment list into the leaf nodes of a sparse voxel octree. It writes computed colors to specific positions within a 3D texture brick (brickPool_value) representing the corners, faces, edges, and center of a voxel unit.
summary: Voxel Color Aggregation into Brick Faces computes averaged colors for all topological elements of a voxel unit to support higher-order interpolation or ray-tracing queries.
